sloka: क एष सुमहाकायो बलेन महता वृतः ।आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो वीर्यवन्तं निशाचरम् ।। ६.५८.२ ।।।।
transliteration: ka eṣa sumahākāyo balena mahatā vṛtaḥ ।ācakṣva me mahābāho vīryavantaṁ niśācaram ।। 6.58.2 ।।।।

translations.english: "Oh, Broad shouldered Vibheeshana! Who is this Rakshasa of gigantic form coming surrounded by a great army He seems to be a valiant one. Tell me."
